title: Status Update April 18, 2026

canonical_node.axiom: The GTQ-01 HTML file is the gold standard for all article templates; all other articles must be stamped with its CSS and JS while preserving their original content.
definitions: Gold Standard: The rebuilt gtq-01-measurement-collapsed-reality.html file, which includes custom audio players, player strips, oversized Born Rule section, decoherence steps, falsification criteria, sign-out cards, canvas chalkboard, and tab rename.
Template Stamping: Replacing the CSS and JS blocks of an existing HTML file with those from GTQ-01, adding player strips, renaming tabs, but keeping all article body content unchanged.
Tangent HTML: An HTML file built from a tangent markdown source using the tangent article template from GTQ-01A as a base.
derivation: GTQ-01 was rebuilt from the ground up with new features and design.
A pipeline run processed all 25 GTQ markdown sources, producing fresh Excel and JSON outputs.
AGENTS.md and articles.json were created to specify the template stamping process and manifest.
The document lists 20 non-GTQ-01 articles that need template stamping and 5 missing tangent HTML files to build.
Design rules and anomalies are provided to guide the cowork's actions.
canonical_node.action: Apply the GTQ-01 template to all 20 non-GTQ-01 articles by replacing CSS and JS blocks, adding player strips, renaming tabs, and preserving original content. Build the 5 missing tangent HTML files from their markdown sources. Continue Phase 2-3 tasks as specified.
boundary: Do not rewrite article body content during template stamping.
Do not address the L8 (GoEmotions) pipeline failure; it is known and non-critical.
Do not fix the audio CDN standardization or empty audio src issues; they are listed as anomalies to fix but not part of the immediate action.
test: Verify that each stamped article has the GTQ-01 CSS and JS blocks verbatim.
Verify that player strips appear at the top of Paper and Tangent tabs with correct audio URLs.
Verify that tab buttons are renamed appropriately.
Verify that original article body content remains unchanged.
Verify no unclosed tags or broken CSS in stamped files.
Verify that the 5 tangent HTML files are built and render correctly.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Enables systematic template stamping of all articles to match the GTQ-01 gold standard, improving consistency and user experience across the website.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the original content and structure of each article while upgrading the visual and interactive elements.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this action, the website will remain inconsistent, with GTQ-01 being the only article with the new design, and the 5 tangent articles will remain missing, degrading the overall site coherence.

overstatement_risks: Assuming template stamping will work identically for all articles without testing.
Assuming the 5 tangent HTML files can be built without issues from markdown sources.
Assuming the design rules are universally applicable without user feedback.
kill_conditions: If GTQ-01 is modified or lost, the gold standard is invalidated.
If AGENTS.md or articles.json are missing or inaccurate, the stamping process fails.
If the existing HTML files have structural inconsistencies that prevent clean CSS/JS replacement.
risk.lean_target: Minimize manual intervention by automating the template stamping process as much as possible, using the manifest and spec to drive changes.

plain_summary: This status update from April 18, 2026, reports that GTQ-01 has been rebuilt as the gold standard for article templates, and a pipeline run has completed. The primary next step is to stamp the GTQ-01 template onto the other 20 articles, build 5 missing tangent HTML files, and continue Phase 2-3 tasks. The document provides design rules and lists anomalies to fix. The action is to execute the template stamping and tangent builds as specified.
